manifest.name: dsh-prompt-booster
manifest.description: Prompt booster for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: one click lightly polishes the composer draft in place (undoable); right-click picks a boost mode (concise, structured, coding, research, academic, English …), edits each mode's template or adds new ones, and chooses which model does the rewrite. Based on dsh-prompt-enhance by rongxingda.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check-release && npm run build && npm test

manifest.author: Yu Han

bundle.text:
# dsh-prompt-boost bundle patch: inserts the prompt-boost plugin row
# into the web profile roster. Applied as a profile bundle layer (the
# `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest field); install with
# `dsh plugin --profile web add link:<repo>/dsh-prompt-boost`.
#
# One package, both halves: the node half (exports ".") runs in the host
# process and registers the POST /prompt-boost/enhance route and the
# /enhance slash command, and declares the "prompt-boost" settings schema
# this entry's config page renders (read live, per request); the
# browser half (declared by `dsh.client`, served from lib/client.js) adds
# the composer enhance button (conversation.input.right), the preview
# panel, and the undo bar (conversation.input.dock).
- insert:
    - id: prompt-boost
      name: dsh-prompt-booster

readme.text:
A prompt booster for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) web GUI. A small button next to the composer: **left-click** polishes the draft and puts it straight back, **right-click** picks a boost mode, edits a mode's template, or chooses which model does the rewrite.

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

> This plugin is a modified version of [dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance) 0.3.2 by [rongxingda](https://github.com/rongxingda) (Apache-2.0). The preview panel, undo, draft guards, rate limits and model-call plumbing come from the original; this project adds boost modes, the mode editor, boost-model choice and the in-place quick boost. See the [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md) and [NOTICE](./NOTICE) for what changed.

- **Left-click: quick boost, applied in place.** No popup: the button spins, the result replaces the composer text, and an **Undo** chip appears above the composer. The quick boost is a light touch: it smooths the wording and adds a few details the draft or conversation clearly implies, stays within about 1.5x the original length, and adds no role line, headings, steps or acceptance criteria. Click again while it runs to cancel; if you edit the draft while waiting, the result opens in the preview instead of overwriting your edits.
- **Right-click: pick a boost mode.** Eight built-in modes: quick boost, concise, structured, fill in details, coding task, research, academic writing, rewrite in English. Every mode except the quick boost shows an original / result preview first, then you apply, copy or cancel. A long press (touch) or the keyboard context-menu key also opens the menu.
- **Edit mode templates, add modes.** The ✎ next to each mode (or → on a focused row) edits its name and template; **＋ Add a mode** at the end creates a new one. Edited built-ins can be restored to default; created modes can be deleted. Modes are saved on the dsh host, so every browser and the `/boost` comm

| Mode editor | Preview panel (dark) |
|---|---|
|  |  |

Requires dsh `>= 0.1.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0` (tested on 0.2.1-rc.3).

From GitHub (the built `lib/` is committed, so nothing is compiled on your machine):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster

readme.section: the desktop app's profile is called "desktop": dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster
readme.text:
```

A prebuilt `dsh-prompt-booster.tgz` is also attached to each [release](https://github.com/HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster/releases). Restart dsh after installing.

> If `dsh-prompt-enhance` is installed too, disable one of them: both add a composer button and share the default shortcut (`Ctrl+Alt+E`).

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-prompt-booster`, then restart dsh.

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Left-click ✨ / `Ctrl+Alt+E` | Boost with the default mode (quick boost by default: applied in place, undoable) |
| Right-click ✨ | Open the mode menu |
| Click a mode in the menu | Boost with that mode |
| ✎ next to a mode, or → on a focused row | Edit its name and template (⌘/Ctrl+Enter saves, Esc goes back) |
| **＋ Add a mode** | Create a mode |
| **Boost model** | Choose the model used for boosting |

A mode's template is appended after the base rewrite rules. Whatever it says, the rewrite keeps your intent, invents nothing, and outputs only the rewritten prompt. Except for the quick boost, the base rules add structure (role, steps, acceptance criteria); to keep a mode short, say so in its template, e.g. "keep it brief, no steps or acceptance criteria".
Edited on dsh's plugin configuration page (`prompt-boost`); changes apply to the next boost without a restart.

| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `quickApply` | `true` | The quick boost replaces the draft directly; off = preview like the other modes |
| `defaultDirection` | `general` | Mode id used by left-click and the shortcut |
| `customDirections` | empty | Modes defined as text, one `id \| name \| instruction` per line (modes saved from the menu editor take precedence) |
| `provider` + `model` | empty | Fixed model route (fill both); a model picked in the menu wins over it |
| `temperature` | `0.3` | Sampling temperature |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `2048` | Output budget of one boost |
| `maxInputChars` | `12000` | Draft length cap; longer drafts are refused, never truncated |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Deadline of one boost |
| `systemPrompt` / `strategyMode` | empty / `replace-default` | Custom base rewrite rules and how they combine with the built-in ones |
| `shortcut` | `ctrl+alt+e` | Keyboard shortcut; empty disables it |
| `streaming` | `true` | Stream the result into the preview panel |
| `contextAware` | `true` | Use the last few turns of the conversation to resolve references |
| `contextMaxMessages` / `contextMaxChars` | `8` /

- Every boost is one model call that sends the draft to the chosen model; with `contextAware` on it also sends the last few turns of the conversation. Turn `contextAware` off when the conversation holds anything sensitive.
- Modes saved from the editor live on the dsh machine in `~/.dsh/prompt-boost/directions.json` (override with `DSH_PROMPT_BOOST_DIRECTIONS_FILE`).
- The boost-model choice is stored in the browser (localStorage).
- The plugin's HTTP routes only accept loopback requests.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster.git
cd dsh-prompt-booster
npm install
npm test          # unit, real-HTTP and component suites

Browser-half changes need a rebuild and a page reload; host-half changes need a dsh restart. Commit `lib/` together with the source, because GitHub installs are not built on the user's machine.

[Apache-2.0](./LICENSE).

- Original work: [dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance) © rongxingda, Apache-2.0.
- Modifications © 2026 Yu Han, also released under Apache-2.0.

Attribution and the list of changes are in [NOTICE](./NOTICE). Thanks to rongxingda for the original implementation.

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）网页界面的提示词提升插件：输入框旁一个小按钮，**左键**直接把草稿润色好并替换回去，**右键**选择提升模式、编辑模式模板、选择用哪个模型来改写。

[English](./README.md) | 简体中文

> 本插件基于 [rongxingda](https://github.com/rongxingda) 的 [dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance) 0.3.2（Apache-2.0）修改而来。预览面板、撤销、草稿保护、限流和模型调用等基础能力来自原插件；在此之上新增了提升模式、模式编辑器、提升模型选择和直接替换的初步提升等功能，具体改动见 [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md) 和 [NOTICE](./NOTICE)。

- **左键：初步提升，直接替换**——不弹窗。按钮转圈，结果回来后直接替换输入框内容，上方出现「撤销」。初步提升是轻量改写：只理顺语句、补充少量上下文中明显隐含的细节，长度约为原文 1.5 倍以内，不加角色、小标题、步骤、验收标准。等待时再点一次按钮可取消；等待期间改了草稿，则不覆盖，改为弹出预览。
- **右键：选择提升模式**——8 个内置模式：初步提升、精简、结构化、补充细节、编程任务、调研分析、学术写作、改写为英文。除初步提升外，其余模式先显示「原文 / 提升结果」对比，再决定回填、复制或取消。触屏长按、或聚焦按钮后按键盘菜单键也能打开。
- **编辑模式模板、添加模式**——每个模式右边的 ✎（或选中后按 →）可修改名称和提升模板；列表末尾「＋ 添加模式」新建模式。内置模式改过后可「恢复默认」，新建的模式可删除。模式保存在 dsh 后端，所有浏览器和 `/boost` 命令共用。
- **选择提升用的模型**——菜单底部「提升模型」列出 dsh 当前可用的模型（与 dsh 自带模型选择器同一份实时列表），只影响提示词提升，不改变对话模型。默认「跟随默认」：插件设置 → 当前会话模型 → dsh 默认模型。
- **斜杠命令**——`/boost [@模式] 文本`，例如 `/boost @coding 修一下登录页的报错`。结果显示在命令区，不进入对话历史。
- **界面跟随 dsh 主题**——颜色、圆角、阴影用 dsh 自己的设计变量，深色/浅色跟随 dsh 的外观设置。

需要 dsh `>= 0.1.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0`（在 0.2.1-rc.3 上测试）。

从 GitHub 安装（仓库里已提交构建好的 `lib/`，安装时不需要编译）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster

readme.section: 桌面版的 profile 名是 desktop：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster
readme.text:
```

也可以从 [Releases](https://github.com/HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster/releases) 下载预构建的 `dsh-prompt-booster.tgz` 安装。装好后重启 dsh。

> 如果同时装了 `dsh-prompt-enhance`，请停用其中一个：两者都会在输入框加按钮，默认快捷键也相同（`Ctrl+Alt+E`）。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-prompt-booster`，然后重启 dsh。

| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 左键点击 ✨ / `Ctrl+Alt+E` | 用默认模式提升（默认「初步提升」：直接替换，可撤销） |
| 右键点击 ✨ | 打开模式菜单 |
| 菜单里点某个模式 | 用该模式提升 |
| 模式右侧 ✎，或选中后按 → | 编辑该模式的名称和模板（⌘/Ctrl+Enter 保存，Esc 返回） |
| 「＋ 添加模式」 | 新建模式 |
| 「提升模型」 | 选择提升使用的模型 |

模板会追加在基础改写规则之后。无论模板怎么写，改写都不会改变原意、不会编造内容、只输出改写后的提示词。除「初步提升」外，基础规则会补充角色、步骤、验收标准等结构；想让某个模式输出简短，就在模板里写明「保持简短，不要加步骤和验收标准」。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `quickApply` | `true` | 初步提升直接替换输入框；关闭后和其他模式一样先预览 |
| `defaultDirection` | `general` | 左键和快捷键使用的模式 id |
| `customDirections` | 空 | 用文本定义的模式，每行 `id \| 名称 \| 指令`（菜单编辑器保存的模式优先级更高） |
| `provider` + `model` | 空 | 固定使用的模型（须成对填写）；菜单里选了模型时以菜单为准 |
| `temperature` | `0.3` | 采样温度 |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `2048` | 单次提升的输出上限 |
| `maxInputChars` | `12000` | 草稿字数上限，超出则拒绝（不会截断） |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次提升超时 |
| `systemPrompt` / `strategyMode` | 空 / `replace-default` | 自定义基础改写规则，以及它与内置规则的组合方式 |
| `shortcut` | `ctrl+alt+e` | 快捷键，留空禁用 |
| `streaming` | `true` | 预览面板边生成边显示 |
| `contextAware` | `true` | 参考当前会话最近几轮对话来补全指代和背景 |
| `contextMaxMessages` / `contextMaxChars` | `8` / `4000` | 参考对话的条数和字数上限 |
| `maxConcurrent` / `rateLimitPerMinute` | `2` / `10` | 并发与每分钟次数上限 |

- 每次提升都是一次模型调用，会把草稿发给所选模型；开启 `contextAware` 时还会附带最近几轮对话。对话里有敏感信息时，可以关掉 `contextAware`。
- 编辑器保存的模式存在 dsh 所在机器的 `~/.dsh/prompt-boost/directions.json`（可用环境变量 `DSH_PROMPT_BOOST_DIRECTIONS_FILE` 改路径）。
- 「提升模型」的选择存在浏览器本地（localStorage）。
- 插件的接口只接受本机（loopback）请求。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster.git
cd dsh-prompt-booster
npm install
npm test          # 单元、真实 HTTP 与组件测试

前端改动重新构建后刷新页面即可；后端改动需要重启 dsh。`lib/` 需要随代码一起提交，因为从 GitHub 安装不会在用户那边构建。
